extracted_text:
From: quality.dept@pharma-cure-labs.com
To: complaints@clinicverse.com
Subject: Quality Complaint - Inconsistent Tablet Coating - Lot PC-2025-3391
Date: 2025-08-20T14:30:00Z

QUALITY COMPLAINT REPORT

Complaint Reference: QC-2025-1204
Date Received: 2025-08-20
Priority: High

Reporter Information:
Name: Jennifer Wu
Title: Quality Control Manager
Organization: PharmaCure Laboratories
Phone: (555) 987-6543
Email: jennifer.wu@pharma-cure-labs.com

Product Information:
Product: Neurocalm 25mg Tablets
NDC: 12345-678-90
Lot Number: PC-2025-3391
Manufacturing Date: 2025-07-01
Expiry: 2027-06-30

Complaint Description:
During routine quality inspection, we identified that approximately 15% of tablets in Lot PC-2025-3391 exhibit uneven coating. The coating appears thinner on one side of the tablet. This may affect dissolution rates and bioequivalence.

Visual inspection shows mottled appearance on affected tablets.
Standard coating thickness specification: 50-80 microns
Affected tablets measured: 25-45 microns (below specification)

Impact Assessment:
- Product distributed to: 3 hospital pharmacies, 12 retail outlets
- No patient adverse events reported to date
- Remaining inventory under quarantine

Category: Manufacturing Defect / Product Quality
Severity: Moderate (potential efficacy impact)

Requested Action:
1. Root cause investigation
2. Recall assessment
3. Corrective action plan within 30 days

Attachments:
- Inspection_Report_PC2025_3391.pdf
- Tablet_Measurement_Data.xlsx
